Tomba Skip FMVs

This default-disabled mod automatically ends full-motion videos through
Tomba's original movie-completion path. The game still performs its normal
teardown and transition to the following screen.

Enable "Preserve New Game and ending FMVs (Any%)" in this mod's options to keep
the opening after New Game, post-final-pig cutscene, and credits playing normally,
with audio. Every other FMV is still skipped, including the movie before the title.
The option is off by default, retaining the original skip-all behavior for
All Events runs. Both choices use the same mod; no second mod is required.

Credit

mstan — FMV skip implementation and mod integration
